Moderate drought: season rainfall below this (100 % of the requirement).
Severe drought: below this (80 % of the requirement).
Extreme drought: below this (60 % of the requirement).

Heat, moderate: daily maximum temperature above this in the crop's heat window. The lowest optimum upper end among the window's stages, from cc4a-hazards window_thresholds (decisions 0006 and 0007; commit 1ea2030). Also the base for heat degree days. Empty where the pipeline has no profile.
Heat, severe: midpoint between the moderate and extreme thresholds (cc4a-hazards). Empty where the crop has no ceiling.
Heat, extreme: the lowest ceiling among the window's stages (cc4a-hazards). Empty where the crop has no ceiling.
